title: 'Freeze', 'Don't Freeze': Trinamool, Ex-Treasurer Over Funds In HDFC Account
description: The Trinamool has been roiled by infighting since losing the April-May election to the BJP. Mamata Banerjee's party - undefeated for 15 years - was thumped, winning only 80 seats as the BJP crossed 200 in the 294-seat Assembly.
